jobs.title: Agile Product Manager
jobs.description: Headquarters: We're looking for a Product Manager to own roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for a digital product initiative, operating within Agile/Scrum frameworks. The role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution — most engagements in this market are technical-delivery-adjacent (software, data, or AI products) rather than purely strategic, so comfort partnering closely with engineering is expected. Key Responsibilities Own the product backlog, prioritization, and roadmap using Agile/Scrum practices Translate business and stakeholder needs into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria Partner closely with engineering teams to scope, sequence, and deliver iteratively Define and track success metrics/KPIs for the product area Facilitate or support Agile ceremonies (backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews) alongside a Scrum Master where applicable (Common variant, ~1 in 5 postings) Own AI/Agentic feature delivery — defining how GenAI or agentic capabilities integrate into the product (Common variant, ~1 in 7 postings) Operate as a Technical PM — comfortable in architecture/API-level discussions, not just business requirements (Frequent industry context) CPG/enterprise data-product ownership — managing data platforms, catalogs, or analytics products feeding business stakeholders Required Skills (Must-Have) Agile Product Management — backlog ownership, iterative delivery, Scrum/Kanban fluency Proven Product Manager, Product Owner, or Technical PM experience Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration (engineering, data, business) Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable product requirements Nice to Have AI/GenAI or Agentic product experience (increasingly common — nearly 1 in 5 current postings) Data product management experience (catalogs, analytics platforms, BI) CPG, enterprise, or regulated-industry domain experience Technical fluency (APIs, data architecture) for Technical PM-flavored roles To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-agile-product-manager

why_matches: Matches Agile product management requirements with 3+ years of end-to-end delivery ownership, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and Jira administration across multiple companies.
Shows deep technical PM fluency, including API-level discussions, reading React/Laravel/PHP/MySQL, and writing precise acceptance criteria that developers don't have to translate.
Directly aligns with the AI/Agentic feature delivery nice-to-have, having shipped 5 AI features end-to-end (including predictive lead scoring, OCR, and AI product search).
Demonstrates strong capability in translating ambiguous needs into structured epics, user stories, and requirements (proven across ERP, CRM, and healthcare EHR platforms).
Global remote location (Addis Ababa, Ethiopia) satisfies the 'Anywhere in the World' eligibility requirement.
jobs.reasoning_summary: Arsema is an exceptional match for this Agile/Technical Product Manager role at Toptal. Her background spans full lifecycle delivery, strong technical fluency, hands-on Agile/Scrum and Jira management, and proven experience shipping AI features, all of which directly address the core and nice-to-have requirements of the posting.

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI & Supplier Management
jobs.description: Description Build smarter procurement with AI at Precoro Precoro is an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform that helps companies automate procurement, reduce manual work, and make better purchasing decisions. We work with 1,000+ customers across 80+ countries, helping businesses make their procurement processes more efficient and transparent. We’re looking for a Product Manager to own and evolve our Supplier Management product area — from supplier discovery and evaluation to contract management and automated purchasing. Imagine helping businesses move from manually comparing suppliers, checking their reliability, and managing contracts to a smarter workflow where AI helps them find the right suppliers and automate routine decisions. That’s the kind of experience we want to build. What makes this role exciting? AI-powered product development. Explore how AI can help businesses identify the best suppliers, make smarter purchasing decisions, and automate routine workflows. End-to-end ownership. Take ideas from discovery and customer research to delivery, launch, and measuring real-world impact. A complex B2B SaaS product. Solve meaningful business problems involving supplier data, purchasing workflows, integrations, and automation. Real customer impact. Your decisions will shape how companies manage supplier relationships and make purchasing decisions. Room to experiment. Challenge existing approaches, validate hypotheses, and turn promising ideas into features customers actually use. What you’ll do Own the Supplier Management product area end-to-end Define the product direction, roadmap, and priorities for your area. Discover customer needs through interviews, feedback, market research, and data analysis. Turn business problems into clear product requirements and actionable solutions. Work closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and other teams to deliver valuable features. Measure feature adoption and business impact after launch, learn from the results, and iterate. Build smarter supplier workflows Your product area includes several exciting directions: AI-driven supplier recommendations: help customers identify the most suitable suppliers for their purchasing needs. Supplier catalog and reliability: make it easier to discover, evaluate, compare, and select suppliers. Contract management: improve how businesses manage supplier contracts and related workflows. Supplier integrations and PunchOut marketplaces: connect Precoro with external supplier catalogs and purchasing systems. Purchase order automation: reduce manual work and make interactions with suppliers more seamless. You won’t simply manage a backlog. You’ll understand the problem, challenge assumptions, decide what matters most, and help the team deliver solutions that create measurable value. What we’re looking for 3+ years of Product Management experience in a product company; 5+ years would be a strong advantage. Experience working with B2B SaaS products and an understanding of how B2B purchasing decisions, workflows, and customer needs differ from B2C. A track record of launching substantial features end-to-end — from discovery, research, and planning to delivery, adoption analysis, and post-launch improvements. Strong product thinking: you can identify the underlying business problem rather than simply implement a requested feature. Confidence in prioritizing competing needs, making independent decisions, and navigating ambiguity. A data-informed approach to product decisions, including defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance. English at B1+ level, preferably B2, with the ability to communicate with customers and external supplier representatives. Nice to have Experience building or improving AI-powered product features. Familiarity with procurement, supplier management, marketplaces, or contract management. Experience with third-party integrations or complex B2B workflows. Experience using AI tools in your everyday product work. You don’t

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst
jobs.description: Company Description Accesa is a leading technology company headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, with offices in Oradea and 21 years of experience in turning business challenges into opportunities and growth. A value-driven organisation, it has established itself as a partner of choice for major brands in Retail, Manufacturing, Finance, and Banking. It covers the complete digital evolution journey of its customers, from ideation and requirements setup to software development and managed services solutions. With more than 1,200 IT professionals, Accesa also has a fast-growing footprint, establishing itself as an employer of choice for IT professionals who are passionate about problem-solving through technology. Coming together in strong tech teams with a customer-centric approach, they enable businesses to grow, delivering value for our clients, partners, industry, and community. Job Description Technical Business Analyst defines, manages, and delivers digital product requirements that support business objectives and operational excellence in Financial Industry. The role ensures a clear, prioritized backlog and strong alignment between business stakeholders, technical teams, and end users. Operating at the intersection of product ownership, business analysis, and process optimization, as well as system integration, The Business Analyst guides solutions from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement. The role requires a solid understanding of APIs and system-to-system integrations, as the Business Analyst will work closely with technical teams to define integration requirements, data flows, and expected system behavior. Our client is a technology-driven insurance platform that enables businesses to embed protection products directly into their customer journeys. Our project will support the client in enhancing its digital insurance capabilities and delivering a seamless, efficient experience for partners and customers. Responsibilities Drive Impact: Your expertise will play a pivotal role in identifying, analyzing, and shaping business needs, ensuring that solutions deliver measurable value and improve end-to-end processes across domains. Own the Product Direction: You will manage and prioritize the product backlog and roadmap, balancing business value, risks, dependencies, and operational constraints to drive informed decision-making. Shape Solutions from Discovery to Delivery: You will lead discovery workshops, analyze AS-IS processes, and define optimized TO-BE solutions, translating complex needs into clear process flows, user journeys, data flows, API requirements and system interactions. Bridge Business and IT: You will act as the connector between stakeholders and technical teams, facilitating collaboration, clarifying business, functional, and integration requirements, and ensuring shared understanding within cross-functional teams. Define API and Integration Requirements: You will analyze system interactions and integration needs, document API-related requirements, define data mappings and expected request-response flows, and collaborate with developers and architects to ensure that integrations support the intended business processes. Translate Needs into Actionable Work: You will convert requirements into structured user stories, acceptance criteria, API-related use cases, and test scenarios, ensuring alignment with the broader ecosystem and operational processes. Enable Successful Delivery with Partners: You will collaborate with internal teams and external providers, preparing detailed requirement packages and validating delivered solutions against expectations, including API and integration requirements. Validate Integrated Solutions: You will support the validation of APIs and system integrations by reviewing specifications, coordinating integration testing, analyzing API responses and errors, and confirming that delivered solutions meet business expectations. jobs.title: System Business Analyst (Remote)
jobs.description: Libertex Group Overview Established in 1997, the Libertex Group has helped shape the online trading industry by merging innovative technology, market movements and digital trends. The multi-awarded online trading platform, Libertex, enables traders to access the market and invest in stocks or trade CFDs with underlying assets being commodities, Forex, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and others. A firm believer in the power of sports to inspire, empower and push for success, Libertex is the Official Online Trading Partner of Audi Revolut F1® Team. We build innovative fintech so people can #TradeForMore with Libertex. Job Overview We are looking for a System Business Analyst in the data department to bridge communication between our business and development teams, translating business needs into clear technical specifications. Responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to identify, analyze, and document business requirements. Translate business needs into acceptance criteria and technical specifications for the development team. Analyze, define, and document detailed system requirements, including functional, non-functional, and integration requirements. Lead system configuration and data mapping efforts, particularly those involving APIs, third-party platforms, and internal system integrations. Support post-release validation and acceptance of features to ensure solutions meet stakeholder expectations. 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst Background in IT or software development Experience in product and marketing analytics Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing data Solid experience in gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements Experience creating data flow diagrams (DFDs) and data architecture diagrams Familiarity with API documentation tools and a basic understanding of REST API concepts Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills Excellent communication skills Spoken English at B2 level or higher Tech Stack Databases and data warehouses: ClickHouse, Redshift, PostgreSQL, BigQuery Analytics and marketing platforms: Mixpanel, GA4, AppsFlyer, Blueshift Data pipelines and streaming: RudderStack, Kafka Nice to Have Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, or Redshift Experience in FinTech, especially CFD trading Familiarity with AI tools for analytics, such as MCP servers and skills Experience with Python or JavaScript Quarterly bonuses based on Company performance 24 working days of annual leave Udemy Business unlimited membership & language training courses Professional and personal development opportunities in a fast-growing environment Libertex Group is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive and diverse environment. We do not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by the law. Candidate privacy is respected, and all data is securely stored and used solely for recruitment purposes, in line with GDPR and our internal policies. Unsuccessful applicants may have their data retained for future opportunities unless deletion is requested.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: Company Overview Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing. Job Purpose and Role The Technical Product Owner (TPO) acts as the bridge between business objectives and technical execution, ensuring that products are developed in alignment with strategic goals and technical standards. As the primary advocate for the customer, the TPO works closely with UI/UX architects, developers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality, value-driven product releases. This role is responsible for guiding the product lifecycle from concept to launch and beyond, ensuring that user needs are met while maintaining technical integrity. As a key leader, the TPO is ultimately accountable for the product’s success and continuous alignment with both business and user expectations. Prior experience in healthcare or healthcare-focused software is considered an advantage. Key Responsibilities Product Ownership & Agile Leadership Act as the primary contact for major system issues and product-related inquiries. Gather and document requirements from clients and internal stakeholders. Manage and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring readiness for development. Lead Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, sprint reviews, and other team meetings. Collaborat closely with developers and QA to ensure product quality, accurate implementation, and smooth releases. Communicate the value of new features to internal teams and clients. Oversee and mentor the Product Owner team, including goal-setting, project assignments, and performance evaluations. Maintain internal tools such as developer PTO and assignment trackers. Regulatory Compliance Handle system certification processes (e.g., ONC, Surescripts, MDToolbox/DEA). Ensure ongoing compliance with healthcare regulations and industry standards. Manual Testing Team Oversight Managed structure and productivity of the manual testing team. Aligned testing timelines with product delivery schedules. Provided regular performance feedback. Clinical Services (MIPS) Oversight Directed MIPS Services in line with financial and strategic objectives. Ensured regulatory compliance and managed escalations. Coordinated with Reg-ent and leadership, delivered financial reporting, and trained new staff on MIPS-related tasks. Qualifications Proven experience conducting user research and synthesizing insights through user flows, personas, and other methodologies. Experience in the healthcare or health technology industry related to medical practices Demonstrated ability to manage conflicting priorities, distinguish between critical roadblocks and distractions, and make sound decisions under pressure. Strong data-driven mindset with experience leveraging analytics to inform product decisions. Proactive and self-motivated, with the judgment to know when to seek guidance. Extensive experience gathering, documenting, and communicating detailed requirements, including functional, technical, reporting, and data needs. Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus across diverse teams and stakeholders. Deep experience working in Agile environments, breaking down epics into actionable stories, and guiding teams through the software development lifecycle. Track record of successful technology product design, implementation, and delivery. Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities. Demonstrated leadership experience, including team management and mentoring. Proficiency with Jira and cloud-based architectures. This is an Independent Contractor position. Job Type: Full-time Remote Hours: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM EST or 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position.

jobs.title: Product Manager at Tratta
jobs.description: About Tratta Tratta is the platform that powers credit and collections at scale, and we try to make it enjoyable to work on. Our clients are collection agencies and law firms recovering debt from consumers. Their account data lands in Tratta and is mapped and validated on the way in. They run email and SMS campaigns off it. Consumers land on a payment portal carrying the client's brand, where they can pay, negotiate a plan or sign an agreement electronically without ever speaking to a collector. Payments clear through us by card, ACH or check, and it all feeds back into reporting that shapes the next campaign. Campaigns, data and payments as one closed loop instead of four vendors stitched together. Every week that loop moves millions of dollars in payments, ingests nearly 100 million rows of client data and serves almost 10 million API requests. About the Product Team The product team is small: two PMs, one designer and a distributed engineering team of about ten. You would be our second product hire. There is no product ops layer, no analyst and no one sitting between you and the client, or between you and the code. The role You will own a set of topics end to end. Not "manage a backlog" in the abstract, but pick up messy input from clients and customer success, turn it into something the team can build, get it shipped, and then make sure it actually gets used. Turn requests into work. Client and CS requests arrive as symptoms, not specs. You dig into what is actually being asked, decide whether it is a bug, a gap, a training problem or a real product need, and write it up so a developer can pick it up without a meeting. Prioritize. You decide what gets built next among a lot of competing, legitimate asks, and you can explain the reasoning to a client, a developer and a founder in three different ways. Firefight. Bugs and urgent client issues will land on you. You triage, reproduce, escalate the real ones, and close the loop with whoever raised it. Discovery. You help figure out what we should build next, from client conversations, usage data and your own read of the market. Data. You are comfortable with data end to end: getting it, questioning it, and deciding what to do about it. Own outcomes, not output. Shipping is the midpoint, not the finish line. If a feature launches and nobody knows it exists or nobody adopts it, that is your problem to solve. You will write the client email, record the walkthrough, check the numbers a month later and tell us honestly whether it worked. Wear multiple hats. Small changes you can do yourself with Claude, you do yourself. Otherwise: specs, debugging, data and dashboards, release notes, client emails, whatever the topic needs. There is no one to hand it to. What this role is not It is not a role where you write requirements and hand them to someone else. It is not a role with a defined scope that stays defined. And it is not a role where you can be effective while waiting to be told what to do. How we work Very little process and very few meetings. No planning ritual that exists to justify the previous planning ritual. If something is not working, we change it the next day. The tradeoff is that nothing will be handed to you. There is no queue of pre-groomed tickets, no one checking whether you did the thing, and no process to hide behind if a topic quietly stalls. Autonomy and accountability come as a pair here. We use Claude heavily across product work: analysis, drafting, prototyping, bulk operations across Linear, Slack, HubSpot and our data. Being fluent with AI tooling is not a bonus point, it is how the job gets done at this team size. You will do well here if you Have shipped real product in a small team Are comfortable being close to the technical detail: reading logs, querying data, understanding an API contract, reproducing a bug before you file it Write clearly and briefly Prefer deciding with 70% of the information over waiting for 100% Are direct.
